name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
title: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd - 544603 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Groww Q4 FY26 call is a retail broking platform update with no supply-side capital-cycle content; management guided margin expansion only if revenue grows above 15%, and gave no numeric guidance.

triggers.label: Industry growth 10-15% CAGR long run
triggers.quote: if you look at a longer frame the industry is growing like a 10% to 15% CAGR

triggers.label: Options retail customers 14 lakh → 17 lakh
triggers.quote: earlier we had around 14 lakh customers on a quarterly basis transacting this time we had around 17 lakh customers transacting

triggers.label: Cost to grow ~INR450-500 cr, lower than revenue growth
triggers.quote: we would have spent very similar to INR450 crores to INR500 crores is kind of spend

guidance.value: Stays roughly INR450-500 crore; to rise a little, but not linear with revenue
guidance.quote: we would have spent very similar to INR450 crores to INR500 crores is kind of spend

guidance.value: Margin expands if revenue grows beyond ~15%; more at 30%
guidance.quote: if our revenue grows beyond let's say 15% th en probably the margin will keep on expanding

guidance.value: Absolute increase in Q1 from appraisals, then stable for Groww platform
guidance.quote: after that, we expect it to be kind of more or less stable for the rest of the year

red_flags.label: Risk-related negative balance costs in cost to operate
red_flags.quote: where in MTF, we actually accounted some of the negative balances, and which we have kind of put it into our P&L as cost to operate

red_flags.label: Regulatory curbs on F&O speculation
red_flags.quote: any concern on the SEBI and government folks liking to sort of curb the speculation in futures and options

evasions.topic: Affluent customer assets and revenue share
evasions.quote: we'll probably get back to you on this. I think, we don't have it on top of our mind.

evasions.topic: Wealth business investment and Fisdom revenue
evasions.quote: it's very early to comment on anything right now

evasions.topic: Average MTF book and commodity ADTO share
evasions.quote: we will start giving commodity related ADTO because we haven't just crossed even a year
